title: Coronavirus Concerns
summary:
The potential impact of this virus on the tanker market
The coronavirus outbreak, which started in the city of Wuhan in China, has spread across several countries in Asia, with confirmed cases in South Korea, Japan, Taiwan as well as Thailand and Singapore. There has also been one case identified in the United States. According to official counts, more than 600 people have contracted the virus and as of today, at least 17 people have died.

children.title: Where the Coronavirus Has Spread
children.summary: The oil market has already traded down as concerns about the coronavirus are mounting and although the tanker market remains strong, rates have started to weaken in recent days. Although these events are not necessarily connected, there is a common element: market psychology is turning negative.
